example_summary: Calculating Book Profit and Allowable Partner Salary for Rao & Jain.
source_provision:
### Statutory Summary Matrix: Partnership Remuneration u/s 40(b)

| Statutory Element | Relevant Section / Rule | Statutory Condition & Limits | Tax Treatment / Legal Consequence |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Book Profit Computation** | Explanation 3 to Section 40(b) | Net Profit as per P&L account computed under Chapter IV-D, adjusted for inadmissible items | Base figure for calculating maximum allowable partner remuneration |
| **Depreciation Allowance** | Section 32 | Must be deducted while computing book profit under Chapter IV-D | Reduces the net profit to arrive at correct book profit |
| **Interest on Capital** | Section 40(b)(iv) | Maximum allowable interest rate is 12 percent per annum | Excess interest over 12 percent is disallowed and added back |
| **Partner Remuneration** | Section 40(b)(v) | Payable only to working partners and authorized by partnership deed | Restricted to statutory slab limits based on book profit |



> [!IMPORTANT]
> Section 40(b)(v) Slabs for Working Partner Salary:
> - On the first ₹ 6,00,000 of book profit: ₹ 3,00,000 or 90% of book profit, whichever is more.
> - On the balance of book profit: 60% of the balance book profit.



> [!WARNING]
> Mandatory Conditions for Remuneration Deduction:
> - Remuneration must be authorized by the partnership deed.
> - Payment must relate to a period after the partnership deed date (no retrospective effect).

director.justification: The question requires stepping through a sequential multi-step tax computation ledger starting from net profit to determine book profit and allowable partner salary under section 40(b).
director.visual_metaphor: A tiered staircase ledger calculating business book profit and unlocking slab deductions step by step.

beat_plan.beat_goal: Establish the firm net profit baseline before adjustments.
Deduct depreciation under section 32 and adjust interest under section 40(b).
Arrive at the final book profit figure for the firm.
Apply the statutory slab rates for working partner salary.
Summarize the maximum allowable working partners salary.

beats.director_goal: Establish the firm net profit baseline before adjustments.

beats.voice_sync_text: ഈ ലാഭത്തിൽ നിന്ന് ആദ്യം Depreciation u/s 32 ആയ ₹ 1,50,000 കുറയ്ക്കണം. കൂടാതെ, Interest @ 12% p.a. എന്ന ലിമിറ്റിൽ ₹ 60,000 മാത്രമേ അനുവദിക്കൂ, ബാക്കി disallowed ആണ്.
beats.director_goal: Deduct depreciation under section 32 and adjust interest under section 40(b).

beats.voice_sync_text: Explanation 3 to Section 40(b) പ്രകാരം അഡ്ജസ്റ്റ്മെന്റുകൾക്ക് ശേഷം നമുക്ക് ലഭിക്കുന്ന Book Profit ₹ 7,90,000 ആണ്.

visual_data.rule: Book profit means net profit computed under Chapter IV-D increased by remuneration if already deducted.

beats.director_goal: Arrive at the final book profit figure for the firm.

beats.voice_sync_text: Section 40(b)(v) പ്രകാരം salary ലിമിറ്റ് നോക്കാം. First ₹ 6,00,000-ന് 90% അല്ലെങ്കിൽ ₹ 3,00,000 whichever is more എടുക്കണം. Balance Book Profit-ന് 60% ആണ് കണക്കാക്കേണ്ടത്.
beats.director_goal: Apply the statutory slab rates for working partner salary.

beats.voice_sync_text: അങ്ങനെ കണക്കാക്കുമ്പോൾ Maximum allowable partners salary ₹ 6,54,000 എന്ന് ലഭിക്കുന്നു. ഇതാണ് ഫേമിന് ഡിഡക്ഷനായി ക്ലെയിം ചെയ്യാൻ കഴിയുന്ന തുക.
